basic_info.description: Well maintained Sunset home ideal for your family! Featuring 2 bedrooms and 1 bathroom. Enjoy cooking gourmet meals in your kitchen complete with new appliances. The spacious living room and formal dining room is perfect for entertaining friends and family. The home features freshly painted interior and exterior and beautiful refinished original hardwood floors. The large backyard is a wonderful retreat for the gardener with so much potential to create your own oasis. Its cross street, Noriega, has an abundance of restaurants, shopping, and grocery stores. Safeway, Stonestown shopping mall, Taraval and Irving Street are just a short drive away. The Sunset Reservoir Park is half a block away with a great view of the city. The location is unbeatable; there is easy access to all parts of San Francisco.
